Looking for an active part-time job in the evening?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can reach their destination on time.

You can start as a Loader, where you place packages onto the conveyor belt, or as an Unloader, where you remove sorted packages from the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. As you gain more experience, you will have the opportunity to perform a variety of tasks within the sorting center.

You will work the evening shift, which starts between 4:30 PM and 5:30 PM and ends at 1:00 AM.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available 2 or 3 days per week, on Monday, Tuesday and/or Wednesday
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are at least 18 years old
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center
- You are able to lift packages weighing up to 25 kg

Our client is a procurement-focused consultancy company supporting organisations on procurement projects and strategic sourcing challenges. They are currently looking for a Team Lead & Sustainable Procurement Advisor to join their team in Rotterdam . 
In this role, you will combine a leadership position with hands-on advisory work. You will guide a team of consultants while working directly with clients on sustainability and circular procurement initiatives, with a strong focus on strategy, stakeholder engagement and implementation.

Your role will be to guide organisations towards a more circular and inclusive economic approach, balancing advisory work and team lead responsibilities at approximately 70/30.

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

Do you work accurately and enjoy keeping logistics operations running smoothly in a dynamic environment? Then this position at Samsung SDS in Tilburg could be the perfect opportunity for you. In this role, you will not be responsible for planning trucks from point A to point B. Instead, you will ensure that the inbound transportation process runs smoothly by monitoring and managing it through various systems. You will track progress, identify discrepancies, and process data accurately.

Your responsibilities include:

- Monitoring and following up on inbound transportation flows (rail and ocean freight) through internal systems
- Checking, analyzing, and processing transportation and planning data
- Identifying delays or irregularities and coordinating with the relevant stakeholders

- Working with Excel reports and data overviews

You will work full-time in a day shift and become part of a close-knit team of experienced colleagues who will provide thorough training and support.

You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in an administrative role where systems and data play a central role. You think ahead, work in a structured manner, and are confident taking responsibility.

You also have:

- A minimum MBO Level 4 working and thinking level (or equivalent vocational qualification)
- Strong administrative and digital skills
- Experience with Microsoft Excel
- Good command of the English language
- Availability to work 40 hours per week

Preferred (not required):

Are you an experienced logistics leader who enjoys optimizing operations and developing teams? Do you know how to combine operational excellence with strategic thinking? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Manager, you are responsible for the overall warehouse operation. You lead Supervisors and Team Leaders, ensure that productivity and quality targets are achieved, and continuously improve processes to deliver the best possible service to customers.

What will you do?
As a Warehouse Manager, you oversee the daily warehouse operation and manage multiple teams through Supervisors and Team Leaders.

Your responsibilities include:

- Managing the overall warehouse operation, including inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound processes
- Leading, coaching, and developing Supervisors and Team Leaders
- Monitoring KPIs, productivity, quality, and operational performance
- Ensuring efficient workforce planning and optimal staffing levels
- Driving continuous improvement projects and implementing new processes
- Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Planning, and customers
- Preparing management reports and analysing operational performance
- Ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and company standards

You are an experienced people manager who enjoys building high-performing teams while continuously improving operational processes.

You also have:

- A completed Bachelor's degree (HBO), preferably in Logistics or Supply Chain Management
- At least 3 years of management experience within logistics or manufacturing
- Strong leadership and coaching skills
- Experience with KPI management and continuous improvement
- Excellent communication skills in Dutch and English
- Strong analytical and organizational skills
- You have your own accommodation
- A valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG). If your VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If your VOG is not approved, the cost will be at your own expense

Are you looking for a fun and dynamic job where you can truly make a difference in logistics?As an Order Picker and Packer at GXO Logistics in Tilburg, you play an essential role in keeping the warehouse running smoothly together with your team. No two days are the same, and your tasks will vary depending on the department you work in.

Online departments

- Picking: You collect products using a scanner and ensure each order contains the correct items before sending them to packing.
- Packing: At a packing station, you scan items, check that orders are complete, and prepare packages for shipment, including printing labels.
- Returns: You inspect returned items for quality and process them correctly, ensuring they are restocked or sent back to the supplier when needed.

You’ll be part of a friendly, international team where communication and teamwork are key. Together, you make sure every order is processed quickly and accurately, so customers receive their orders with a smile.

Retail department

- PBR (Retail operations): In this department, you handle products intended for in-store use. You can be trained in multiple processes, including Picking, Receiving, Put-Away, Allocation, Inbound, and Outbound.

Here, you’ll work in a close-knit team, ensuring that all products are handled with care and efficiency from the moment they arrive at the warehouse until they are shipped to stores.

Hard requirements

- You can communicate in English (minimum B1 level).
- You are physically fit and able to stand and walk for extended periods.
- You are available to work either a fixed morning shift or in a two-shift rotation.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You are able to apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).
- You are available full-time and can work from Monday to Saturday in 2 shifts.

Morning shift 06:00 – 14:45 and Afternoon shift 15:15 – 00:00

jobs.description:
The Korean word Samsung translates to "three stars". This reflects to the vision of the founder of the company. A company that is continously growing, improving and will always be a very strong brand. At Samsung SDS we support this vision by assisting Samsung by fullfilling a large part of their supply chain. In our Warehouse in Tilburg, we make sure that different items as tv's, microwaves and vacuumcleaners, washing machines and refridgerators are correctly distributed to their customers. During the day, trucks come in to be unloaded and loaded. The items that come in, need to be checked, put in the right place and prepared for loading. 

Right now, we are looking for:

- Reachtruck drivers to assist in Picking and Putaway
- Forklift and Clamp Drivers to assist loading and unloading
- Warehouse Operators for preparing pallets for transport
- Pickers (please be aware that the items that need to be picked are larger items such as tv's and soundbars)

All this is being done in two shifts. A morning shift from 06.00 to 14.30 and and evening shift from 14.30 to 23.00. You will be working both shifts. It is not possible to work in only one. 

When you are hired as a driver you will also be expected to help with other tasks that need to be done. You will not only be on the forklift of reachtruck.

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. Since you'll be working in shifts, public transport is NOT possible!
- You speak and understand English, which is needed in this international environment. This can be tested during the tour!
- You are available full-time and can work both shifts
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation. We do NOT provide it!
- You are available for a longer period of time.

It is prefered that you are flexible. Sometimes we work until 1 a.
